name: What credentials or certifications should a crime scene cleanup company have?

mainEntity.name: What credentials or certifications should a crime scene cleanup company have?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reputable crime scene cleanup company should possess certifications from recognized organizations in biohazard remediation and restoration. Look for certifications related to bloodborne pathogen training, hazardous waste operations (HAZWOPER), and personal protective equipment (PPE) usage. Companies should also adhere to OSHA regulations and EPA guidelines for biohazard removal and disposal. These credentials ensure technicians are properly trained, follow safety protocols, and use effective cleaning and disinfection methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: A reputable company should have certifications in biohazard remediation, bloodborne pathogens, HAZWOPER, and PPE, adhering to OSHA and EPA guidelines for safety and effectiveness.
